body:
Advisor queue for Codex, 18:10. Work these IN ORDER after the docs round-2 ruling and TASK-HOME-117. One spec per worktree and one PR each, via /aida-pr. make check-ci-fast before every push. All are approved.

1. BUG-HOME-020: `aida alias --help` still says "Built-in shortcuts only." Describe built-ins AND user aliases (personal ~/.aida/aliases.toml, project .aida/aliases.toml). Fasttrack-sized.
2. BUG-ASTER-001: `aida scaffold status/diff` reports a user-owned README.md (FileCategory::Seed) as AIDA drift. Seed files that the user has changed are user-owned: exclude them from drift and diff, or show them as "user-owned (seeded)". Full analysis is in the spec.
3. BUG-HOME-026: `aida node list` prints only the current node's summary. List every known node (labels from registry/node_aliases.toml, legacy entries from registry/nodes.toml), with the label, hostname/clone path when known, role, and a `*` on this clone.
4. SPIKE-HOME-002: can AIDA wake an idle Antigravity (agy) session when mail arrives? Time-box it to 1h and write the findings into the spike (try `agy --conversation <id> -p` and `agy remote-control`). No product code. This feeds the wake-adapter design in STORY-HOME-096.

Mail the advisor each PR number as you open it. Note: your inbox shows "partial", so acks fail. TASK-HOME-118 is fixing that; until it lands, an unacked mail is expected, not an error.
subject: Next Codex queue after docs round 2 + TASK-117
